title: Phase 5 local RealBasicVSR smoke passes; sweater A20 A40 not promoted
body: CONFIRMED: local RTX2060 Torch2.11+cu128 executed pinned MMEditing RealBasicVSR via narrow infrastructure adapter, official checkpoint hash verified, all320 state keys strict-loaded; repeat synthetic smoke delta 0.0. Eighteen actual sweater frames116-133 at native512x224 were processed in six seven-frame windows,14.663s synchronized inference,27.704s runner,1.287GiB peak allocated VRAM. B2 OFF master SHA08e73ade1fa0048f33a5701502f6825428ee392c4e8748ddab6cffb1093779b5 frozen. A20/A40 differ only blend0.2/0.4, mask protects accepted real donors and all outside sweater support. Full147-frame lossless master decode proves zero altered pixels outside candidate support. Temporal proxy changed -1.294%/+0.122%, not proof of flicker-free perception. Visual sample judgment: synthetic band remains; more acutance does not prove texture recovery. Both REJECT for promotion, B2 retained. Motion comparison has SOURCE,V3,B2,A20,A40 and Vmake reference only; Vmake never model input/donor/GT. Commercial-reference constant-3 motion alignment has documented frame124 nearest-match exception. No full-scene inference, no production, no paid resource started; incremental cloud cost USD0, electricity unmeasured. Model GT metrics null. Browser playback tested; independent blinded motion assessment pending, not fabricated. Scope one short clip, not general superiority or parity with legacy runtime. Clarification of earlier compact typography: repeat_max_abs was exactly0.0, sample count18; see smoke.json. Delivery VUI metadata repaired without re-encoding; decoded YUV hashes match before and after.
